messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Two knowledge-graph relations extracted from drug information texts are given below. Decide whether they express the same meaning with the same subject/object direction, so that they can be merged into one relation without losing information.

Relation A: 'has maintenance dose' defined as 'The subject drug may have its daily dose adjusted in specified increments at weekly intervals to achieve an optimal response.'
Example triple with A: ["Adderall", "has maintenance dose", "may be increased to 20 mg per day after one week if symptoms are not adequately controlled"]
Relation B: 'requires adjustment of' defined as 'The subject drug necessitates changes or modifications to the treatment or dosage specified by the object entity.'
Example triple with B: ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "requires adjustment of", "diabetes medicine or insulin dose"]

Do relations A and B express the same meaning, so that every triple using A could use B instead without changing the fact it states? Answer with only "yes" or "no".
Answer:
